title: MAIN THEME EPISODE 16: ABNORMAL SPECTRUM
lines: DETAILS: During the period from March 19, 08:00 to April 2, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7), the unlock requirement for Main Theme Episode 16: Abnormal Spectrum will be temporarily lowered. By clearing Main Theme 3-8 , players can earn the [Flint] for a limited time by completing stages in the Abnormal Spectrum. (Flint can be used to redeem items in Humanitarian Assistance.)

◆ After April 2, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7), players need to clear Main Theme 15-21 to unlock Abnormal Spectrum, and the limited-time drop of [Flint] will end. During the event period, players' progress and First Clear Rewards obtained in Abnormal Spectrum will not be reset.
◆ After the EP16 Abnormal Spectrum unlocks, players can earn Simulation Points from Strategic Simulation for extra rewards (Originite Prime, Elite Materials) and unlock Extreme Mode.
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Footprints] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: EPOQUE Collection - Cloud in Foreign Lands for Windscoot, Plaque 'Golden Blood', Elite Materials, LMD, etc.

From March 19, 2026, 08:00 to April 2, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7), players can obtain Flint by completing missions in [Footprints]. (Unclaimed Flint from limited-time missions completed before April 2, 2026, 03:59 can still be claimed until April 9, 2026, 03:59.)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Flint by clearing event stages and completing [Footprints]. Flint can be used to redeem items from [Humanitarian Assistance].

REWARDS: Emergency Sanity Sampler, Rhodes Island Supply Crate (contains Emergency Sanity Sampler*1 and Rhodes Island Supplies Ⅸ*1), 'Elite Operator Lounge' Furniture (Pieces), Witch Feast Series - Imp's House for Rope, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – THE SILENT WAVELENGTHS
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [The Silent Wavelengths], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:

This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
The following Operators will be added to the game:
◆ Mantra, Vetochki and Snegurochka will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after April 2, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).
◆ Mantra, Vetochki and Snegurochka will gain more trust from all sanity-consuming stages, except Annihilation and Intermezzi, from March 19, 2026, 08:00 to April 2, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7).
04 STORYBOARD BREAKER SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Storyboard Breaker Series - The Chainsaw Nurse for Narantuya
Storyboard Breaker Series - Under Surgical Lights for Mitm
Storyboard Breaker Series - Biochemical Submergence for Greyy the Lightningbearer
Storyboard Breaker Series - The Nursing Home Creepshow for Haze

DETAILS: The Fashion Review will be available at the Outfit Store, including 18 Outfits in total: Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA018 for Eyjafjalla, Coral Coast Collection - Silent Night DN02 for Shining, Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA017 for Angelina, and more.

◆ After participating in Fashion Review using Orundum, players will randomly get an Outfit from a specified pool, and each player may participate once during the event period. Turns into a Review Ticket if all Fashion Review items have been obtained (allowing you to redeem an Outfit of your choice in the latest season of Rhodes Fashion Review).
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed Furniture, 'Elite Operator Lounge' will be available during the event.
◆ Abnormal Spectrum event rewards and redeemable (pieces)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: The Silent Wavelengths Headhunting Permit * 2
CONTENTS: The Silent Wavelengths Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1

◆ The [The Silent Wavelengths Headhunting Permit] can only be used for a single headhunting in the Limited-time Headhunting, [The Silent Wavelengths], while the [The Silent Wavelengths Ten-roll Headhunting Permit] can only be used for a Ten-roll headhunting in the [The Silent Wavelengths].
◆ Both the [The Silent Wavelengths Headhunting Permit] and [The Silent Wavelengths Ten-roll Headhunting Permit] will expire on April 2, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7).
CONTENTS: Caster Dualchip * 4, Caster Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Please stay tuned for more information!
